Institutionalization of Quality Management Systems in
Government All departments and agencies of the Executive branch, including all
government-owned and/or controiled corporations (GOCCs) and government financial
institutions (GFIs), are hereby directed to adopt the ISO 9001:2000 Quality
Management Systems as part of the implementation of a government-wide quality
management program. The guality management systems shall be certified for
demonstrated conformity with ISO 9001:2000 and the applicable Government Quality
Management Systems Staniards (GQMSS), with priority to be given. to. frontline

The State Universities and Colleges (SUCs) are likewise enjoined to establish ISO
Quality Management Systems (ISO-QMS) and be certified accordingly. The Local
Government Units (LGUs), Judiciary, the Legislature and the Constitutional offices are
also encouraged to develop ISO-QMS and pursue certification.

Components of the GOMP. The GQMP shall have the following
key components:
1. Government Quality Management Systems Standards. This component shall
involve the develooment of a guidance document and the adaptation of
relevant ISO management systems and standards that integrate relevant
provisions of pertinent laws and/or rules and regulations to develop a culture
of quality and integrity in govemance characterized by citizen-focused and
well-performing government organizations.
2. Advocacy and Capability Building. This component is expected to promote
awareness, generate support, harness resources, and develop organizational
capabilities in the establishment, implementation and continuine improvement
of quality management systems in public sector organizations.
3. Certification of Agencies OMS to GOM5S. The Philippine Certification for ISO
Quality Monagement Systems (PISO-OMS) shall be established to give due
recognition to qualified covemment organizations that have demonstrated
conformity of their QMS to ISO 9001:2000 and the GOMSS. As such, this
component shall establish the structure and mechanisms to ensure the
credibility of all aspects of certification in line with said standards.

Institutional Structure and Mechanisms. There is hereby
created a Government Quality Management Committee (GOMC) to formulate policies
and oversee the implementation of the GOMP.
POMA HINdIAN A 38050

1. Composition of the GOMC. The GQMC shall be composed of the heads of the
following agencies:
Department of Budget and Management as Chairman;
Department of Trade and Industry as Co-Chairman;
Department of the Interior and Local Government as member;
Office of the President-Internal Audit Office as member; and
Development Academy of the Philippines as member.
2. Functions of the GOMG. The GQMC shall have the following specific powers
•and functions:
Serve as the steering and policy-making body for the GQMP;
Approve the standards, guidelines and institutional mechanisms to
implement the program;
Coordinate with Leaques and LGUs in the formulation of standards
and mechanisms to be adopted b the latter to ensure GOMS
certification at the local level:
Coordinate with specific departments and agencies to attend to, or
address constraints in the implementation of relevant Program
activities;
Formulate necessary mechanisms to sustin the implementation of
ISO-QMS among public sector organizations, including measures to
fund the effort, as well as recognition/incentive schemes. for
Program participants;
Monitor and evaluate the implementation of the GOMP and, when
necessary, effect appropriate adjustments thereon in the light of
changing conditions in both the domestic and international
environments; and
Submit progress reports to the President.
3. Resource Fersons. The GOMC may invite representatives from the COA, CSC,
local leaques and local chief executives as its resource persons.
4. Technical Working Group or the GOMC The GOMC shall establish technical
working groups (TIG) for the effective implementation of the GOMP, when it
deems it necessary.
5. Secretariat. The GOMC shall organize a secretariat to provide technical and
administrative support to the GOMC. The Secretariat shall report directly to
the GOMC and be manned by personnel of the member agencies of the

Funding. The implementation of the GQMP at the agency level
shall be funded by the existing appropriations of departments/agencies. The DBM

Secretary is likewise authorized to set aside funds in pursuit of certain Program
activities.

Implementing Rules and Regulations and Guidance
Document. The GQMC shall immediately issue the necessary implementing rules and
regulations and the guidance document.

Repealing Clause. Provisions of existing administrative issuances,
rules and regulations regarding the institutionalization of quality management systems
in Government inconsistent with this Order are hereby repealed accordingly.
SECTION S. Effectivity. This Executive Order shall take effect upon its
publication in a national newspaper of general circulation.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 23rd day of February
